office_does: The county treasurer collects property taxes, receives all money due the county and pays out county funds.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Treasurer Carla Rowe, in office since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Columbia County Treasurer since 2019 and owner of a bookkeeping business, running unopposed with no party preference.
highlights: Treasurer since 2019; owner of CJ Bookkeeping since 2004 [S1]
Cites refinancing the public works building loan and online tax payments; collection rate near 98% [S1]
Served on the state Clean Energy Property Tax Impacts Task Force, 2024-2026 [S1]
